trace.question:
I didn't send any payment, because Borealis Freight has two approved invoices and you asked me to pay one:

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-29161 | $3,308.08 | Approved | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-60893 | $7,366.39 | Approved | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-59731 | $3,174.69 | Draft, awaiting approval | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-76947 | $5,554.38 | Already paid | 2026-09-30 |

No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Which one should I pay: INV-29161 (due first), INV-60893, or both? Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll pay by wire, or by ACH if wire isn't available. I'll use an idempotency key so it only goes through once.

trace.message: Pay INV-60893, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-60893, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Borealis Freight's invoice INV-60893 in full by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-60893 (due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $7,366.39
- **Method:** Wire, sent and verified. INV-60893 should now be marked as paid.

I sent it once, with an idempotency key so a repeat request can't pay it twice. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. Since INV-29161 ($3,308.08) is under dispute, I left it unpaid, and the draft invoice INV-59731 is still waiting for approval.
